intro.en: An alert rule watches one reading and notifies you when it crosses a limit you choose, so you hear about a problem before it costs you.

items.text: The sensor and the reading to watch, for example air temperature.
The condition: above or below a value.
Who is notified when the condition is met.

alt.en: Screenshot of the alert rule editor in CropWatch

content.text: Set the limit slightly inside the point where damage starts, so that you have time to act. Avoid limits so tight that normal daily swings trigger them.
